atoms.text:
This summer, Clara wants to go to the city Siena in Italy to visit her good friend Leonardo. She decided to buy a travel guide to get some information about the city.

Select the travel guide to hear interesting information about Siena.

instruction.text: Read the text and answer the questions.

atoms.text: Siena is an old city in Italy. This picture shows the main square of Siena. The Italian name for this square is Piazza del Campo. It is surrounded by very old buildings. Many of them are more than 700 years old. The city has a long history and many old traditions that still exist today.

atoms.text: Contrada is the Italian word for neighbourhood within a city. There are 17 contradas in Siena, and each contrada has its own flag with bright colours. Some contradas are named after animals, while others are named after objects.

atoms.text: In Siena, Clara met up with Leonardo. He tells her about a traditional horse race called Palio.
atoms.sound: ssml: In Siena, Clara met up with Leonardo. He tells her about a traditional horse race called Palio.

instruction.text: Listen to Clara and Leonardo’s dialogue and answer the questions.

atoms.b: Hi Clara, nice to see you again. Have you already heard about the traditional horse race here in Siena?
atoms.sound: ssml: Hi Clara, nice to see you again. Have you already heard about the traditional horse race here in Siena? <break time='1500ms'/>

atoms.b: No, I haven’t read anything about it in my travel book. Please tell me more about it.
atoms.sound: ssml: No, I haven’t read anything about it in my travel book. Please, tell me more about it. <break time='1500ms'/>

atoms.b: Many people from Siena come together to the main square of the city to watch the race. Traditionally, every contrada has a team of one horse and one horse rider. Each team races against each other and tries to win.
atoms.sound: ssml: Many people from Siena come together to the main square of the city in order to watch the race. <break time='1000ms'/> Traditionally, every contrada has a team of one horse and one horse rider. Each team races against each other and tries to win.<break time='1500ms'/>

atoms.b: Look at this photo. This is what the main square looks like while the race is happening. The horse race is called Palio, and it has existed for more than 700 years.

atoms.b: Wow, that’s incredible! Thank you for telling me all about the horse race Palio.

atoms.a: How long has the Palio existed?
